title: AI and the Everything in the Whole Wide World Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing and reviewing the country-level geo-location data of image sources in datasets like ImageNet to demonstrate Western-centric overrepresentation and a lack of global diversity.

Reviewing disaggregated analysis and external audits that expose intersectional performance disparities (e.g., higher error rates for darker-skinned individuals) and documenting the inclusion of racial/ethnic slurs in dataset taxonomies.

Reviewing disaggregated performance analysis of commercial products across gender subgroups and highlighting the systemic underrepresentation and marginalization of transgender and gender-nonconforming identities in training sets.

Critiquing the construct validity of natural language benchmarks (like GLUE) that claim to measure "general" language understanding while exclusively relying on a specific subset of American English text.
